Time: 1 min. Teaching intent: Explain one design decision and check understanding.
Talk track: Ask students to name one missing input that would make a geometry drawing premature.
Expected answer / misconception: Ask learners to trace the visual and name the next evidence check.

Time: 2 min. Teaching intent: Explain one design decision and check understanding.
Talk track: Pause for an individual response. The answer needs interface width and data rate together with electrical and physical constraints.
Expected answer / misconception: No. Specify the interface, quantity, units, operating point, and acceptance rule.
Visual: gate diagram: high bandwidth; enough detail?; state units.
[Sources]
R2: IEEE EPS HIR 2024, Ch. 13: Co-Design | https://eps.ieee.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/HIR_2024_ch13_HIR_Co-Design.pdf

Time: 2 min. Teaching intent: Explain one design decision and check understanding.
Talk track: Contrast sustained traffic with short bursts; equal peak bandwidth can imply different thermal and power demands.
Expected answer / misconception: Ask learners to trace the visual and name the next evidence check.
Visual: flow diagram: application; traffic pattern; physical design.
[Sources]
R2: IEEE EPS HIR 2024, Ch. 13: Co-Design | https://eps.ieee.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/HIR_2024_ch13_HIR_Co-Design.pdf

Time: 2 min. Teaching intent: Explain one design decision and check understanding.
Talk track: Use bandwidth, power, outline and service temperature as examples. Do not invent targets for the real course case.
Expected answer / misconception: Ask learners to trace the visual and name the next evidence check.
Visual: matrix diagram: requirement; target and unit; check method.
[Sources]
R2: IEEE EPS HIR 2024, Ch. 13: Co-Design | https://eps.ieee.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/HIR_2024_ch13_HIR_Co-Design.pdf

Time: 2 min. Teaching intent: Explain one design decision and check understanding.

Visual: record diagram: quantity; load and ambient; acceptance test.

Talk track: Add the three groups aloud. The values are synthetic classroom numbers and include no routing or yield margin. Every numerical value on this slide is synthetic classroom data, not an InPack.AI output.

Visual: budget diagram: 800 signals; 240 P/G; 40 test.
